lens: E - US and Asian trends not yet in the EU

ideas.name: Magnetic Fridge-Side Spice Shelf System
ideas.concept: Nordic-designed magnetic spice jar set (steel-lid jars, magnetic rail/tray, pre-printed SV/DA/DE labels) that mounts on fridge or hood, sold with refill spice pouches.
ideas.target_customer: Small-flat urban households in SE/DK, renters, gift buyers
ideas.problem_solved: No cabinet or counter space for spices; small-kitchen clutter.
ideas.trend_evidence: Magnetic fridge spice racks are heavily featured in US editorial picks (Aldi US sells a USD 4.99 version; Yamazaki magnetic organizers covered by Apartment Therapy). Evidence is editorial roundups, not sales data; US not verified as rising via Amazon rank.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Own jar/label design system plus refill pouches (consumable repeat); local-language labels and Nordic aesthetic; modular add-ons.
ideas.tooling_needed: None; stock jars, custom label print and packaging only

ideas.name: Soft-Egg Kit (ramen/onsen egg maker + marinade sachets)
ideas.concept: Heat-safe borosilicate/silicone soft-boiled and marinated egg maker bundled with Nordic-flavoured marinade sachets (e.g. dill-soy, smoked), sold as refillable kit.
ideas.target_customer: Home cooks 25-40 following Asian-food content; gift buyers
ideas.problem_solved: Hard to get consistent jammy/onsen eggs and ramen eggs at home.
ideas.trend_evidence: Daiso's Seasoned Egg Maker went viral and sold out in Japan (2021); Daiso onsen egg maker (Yamada, 110 yen) reviewed March 2026 by SoraNews24. No evidence found of a strong EU equivalent, but I did not verify EU shelf supply and virality of the 2026 onsen product is NOT confirmed.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Consumable marinade sachets (own formulation, repeat purchase) and recipe content/community; hardware alone is copyable.
ideas.tooling_needed: None if stock silicone/glass; food-contact (LFGB/EU 1935/2004) testing and food-labelling for sachets

ideas.name: Fridge/Cabinet Magnetic Sponge and Brush Sink Holder
ideas.concept: Stainless, magnetic-mount holder for sink-interior wall with drip catch, sized for Swedish dishcloths and Nordic brushes.
ideas.target_customer: Design-aware kitchen owners in SE/DK with steel sinks
ideas.problem_solved: Wet sponge clutter and drip on counter.
ideas.trend_evidence: A 2026 kitchen-trends article flags magnetic sink-interior sponge holders; sink caddies recur in US editorial roundups. Trend signal is thin and from a vendor blog (Magisso sells in this space).
ideas.defensibility_angle: Weak alone; bundle with Swedish-cloth consumable subscription and sink-material-specific magnet design.

ideas.name: Vertical Cutting-Board and Baking-Sheet Rack, Japanese-style
ideas.concept: Slim adjustable steel-wire vertical divider for cutting boards, trays and lids sized to EU/Nordic cabinet widths (60 cm modules).
ideas.target_customer: Renters and small-kitchen owners; Ikea-cabinet users
ideas.problem_solved: Flat stacking of boards/trays wastes drawer space.
ideas.trend_evidence: Japanese organization YouTubers reportedly favor Daiso vertical storage for boards and sheets (per travel/blog coverage); Tasting Table covers Daiso kitchen-organization hacks. Weak, secondhand evidence; Amazon category is crowded.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Sizing to Ikea METOD/Nordic cabinet modules and design registration; otherwise copyable.

ideas.name: Nordic Fermentation and Pickling Jar Kit
ideas.concept: Glass jars with airlock lids, glass weights and a Swedish/Danish pickling spice-mix refill, positioned as kimchi/sauerkraut/pickles starter.
ideas.target_customer: Fermentation hobbyists, Nordic foodies, gift buyers
ideas.problem_solved: Messy, error-prone home fermenting; kimchi smells.
ideas.trend_evidence: Korean airtight/fermentation containers sold widely on global marketplaces; no verified 2026 virality or rising-demand data found. Included as a hypothesis only.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Own spice-blend refills and local recipes; hardware has stock competitors.
ideas.tooling_needed: None; stock components, glass weights custom optional
